previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for post-procedural monitoring after undergoing a flexible bronchoscopy with balloon dilation for recurrent tracheal stenosis related to relapsing polychondritis. He experienced throat pain post-procedure, which was managed with oxycodone. He remained stable throughout the admission with no respiratory compromise. A short course of prednisone was initiated to reduce airway inflammation. Bronchial washings showed gram-negative rods pending culture, but no acute infection was evident. He was discharged home the following morning with instructions to follow up in interventional pulmonology and to complete the steroid taper.
problems: Bronchitis, not specified as acute or chronic
Chronic respiratory failure, unspecified whether with hypoxia or hypercapnia
